headline: Bruins hit the road for Winnipeg as football Sunday looms large
morning_brew: No baseball for us this morning, which is probably a mercy after the way we finished things up in the Bronx. The silence at the Fens is heavy, and while we're stuck waiting for next spring, the rest of the calendar doesn't care. My mother always said you can't dwell on a bad season once the leaves start changing, and she is right. It is time to shift gears and see if the black and gold can keep their momentum going on this early-season trek through Canada.

The Bruins are heading to Winnipeg tonight for a date with the Jets at Canada Life Centre. It is a fresh start after that opening win, and I am dying to see if our top lines can keep that same level of composure away from the Garden. I have been watching this team long enough to know road games are where you really find out who you are, especially in October when everyone is still trying to figure out their identity. We shall see if our group has the legs to handle a hostile crowd.

Looking further ahead, I am already pacing the floor thinking about Sunday in Buffalo. The Patriots are looking to bounce back against the Bills, and honestly, the uncertainty is killing me. My buddy Sully thinks we are gonna come out and shock the world, but Sully once tried to convince me that a rainy day in Foxborough was a tactical advantage. I am just hoping we show up with a pulse and play some disciplined ball, because another loss would make the upcoming week feel about a decade long.
